arguments.command:
python -c "
import re
from parse import Parser, PARSE_RE, REGEX_SAFETY

pattern = '{{literal}}'
print(f'Pattern: {pattern!r}')
parts = PARSE_RE.split(pattern)
print(f'Parts from split: {parts}')

for part in parts:
    if not part:
        continue
    elif part == '{{':
        print(f'  {{-> {repr(r\"\\\\{)}')
    elif part == '}}':
        print(f'  }} -> {repr(r\"\\\\})')
    elif part[0] == '{':
        print(f'  Field: {part!r}')
    else:
        # just some text to match
        escaped = REGEX_SAFETY.sub(lambda m: '\\\\' + m.group(), part)
        print(f'  Text: {part!r} -> {escaped!r}')
"
